evaluated: frozen retrieval, binding and local geometry prototypes
summary_zh: 本轮三个原型均未达到替换当前 v1 的条件。八槽多覆盖 298 条 Acc@25 可恢复输入，其中 235 条通过分差上限的检查，最终在这 298 条中选中达标框 0 条。固定四槽的正确角色检索增加覆盖，但其总体选框成绩低于错配控制。物理屏蔽消除了规则能够识别的同支持配对，对定位的增量没有超过错配屏蔽。固定同一主体的局部几何细化在 Acc@50 上救回 8 条、损伤 11 条。组合的三项总体指标均低于当前 v1。
retrieval: Coverage gain is attributable to changed shortlist membership. Frozen scoring did not convert the added coverage into task gains.
binding: Duplicate-support exclusion works as wired. Identity correctness is unmeasured. The unphysical column-shift control achieved a larger task effect.
geometry: This untrained same-support median shifts center and size at fixed yaw and query. It failed the paired Acc@50 and mIoU comparison.
scope: All 3072 direction records use a previously exposed ordinary TRAIN panel and fixed inference settings. Source-supervised retrieval and regression heads were outside this first frozen comparison.
